topSpeedMPS.citation: Zero published on-ice youth data exists below age 9 (the nearest real sample, PMC11358090, is ages 9-11 pooled). Linear extrapolation from the U11 real anchor (7.60 m/s) using the 0.4865 m/s-per-year growth rate averaged across the four real U11-U18 data points (docs/scenario-engine/physics-sourcing.md), projected down to age 8.

accel0to10mS.citation: Same extrapolation method as topSpeedMPS, applied to the U11 anchor's 10m acceleration time, age 8.

avgAccelMPS2.citation: Computed from THIS profile's own displayed accel0to10mS (2.04s) via kinematics (a = 2d/t^2, d=10m): 20/2.04^2 = 4.81. Tagged derived-from-estimate, not derived-from-citation -- see u7.json for why. (Corrected 2026-07-30: an earlier version stored 4.80, computed from an unrounded intermediate value that didn't reproduce from the displayed inputs -- caught by adversarial review.)

turningRadiusM.citation: No published turning-radius figure exists at any age. Estimated as v^2 / (0.6 * avgAccelMPS2) = 6.627^2 / (0.6*4.81) -- see u7.json for the assumption this rests on.

stoppingDistanceM.citation: No published stopping-distance figure exists at any age. Estimated as v^2 / (2 * avgAccelMPS2) = 6.627^2 / (2*4.81).

reactionDelayS.citation: See u7.json -- same flat 300ms applied across all bands; no age-hockey reaction-time curve exists in the literature to scale by.

passSpeedMPS.citation: Scaled from the U18 pass-speed reference (18 m/s) by this band's topSpeedMPS ratio to U18's -- see u7.json for the full method and its limits.

iceDecelerationMPS2.citation: mu*g, Hache's puck-on-ice friction coefficient (~0.1) x standard gravity. Real, age-independent physical constant.
